blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Two times the quantity three x plus four y minus five.
There are three terms inside, so the two multiplies all three of them.
Two times three x is six x. Two times four y is eight y. Two times five is ten, and the minus sign stays.
So the answer is six x plus eight y minus ten.
Watch out for these traps. If you multiply only the first term, you get six x plus four y minus five. If you skip the last term, you get six x plus eight y minus five.
